messages.privacy_note: Piper voices run entirely on this computer. Hariku only connects to download the Piper program and the voices you choose, from GitHub and Hugging Face.
messages.page_help: Piper voices speak on this computer, without the internet. Download a voice here, then choose "Piper neural voices (offline)" as the source in Preferences, Hariku Voice.
messages.catalogue_refreshed: The voice list is up to date.
messages.status_stale: Showing the saved voice list; it could not be updated. {error}
messages.status_load_failed: The voice list could not be loaded. {error}
messages.details_card_missing: No model card was saved for this voice.
messages.details_card_pending: The model card, with the dataset and its license, is shown when you press Download.
messages.card_license_missing: License: not stated in the model card.
messages.license_unclear: The model card doesn't name a clear license for this voice's dataset. Check the dataset page before relying on it.
messages.card_empty: The model card has no dataset or license lines.
messages.confirm_size_runtime: Download size: {size} for the voice, plus {runtime} for the Piper program, which is needed once. {total} in total.
messages.confirm_license_missing: Dataset license: not stated in the model card.
messages.confirm_remove: Remove the voice {name}? You can download it again later.
messages.not_in_catalogue: {name} is not in the voice list. Press Refresh catalogue and try again.
messages.busy: Another download is running. Wait for it, or press Cancel download.
messages.download_done: {name} is ready. Choose it in Preferences, Hariku Voice.
messages.card_failed: The model card of {name} could not be loaded, so its license can't be shown. {error}
messages.remove_failed: {name} could not be removed. It may be in use; try again in a moment.
messages.err_offline: Hariku couldn't connect. Check your internet connection.
messages.err_host: Hariku refused to download from {host}, which is not GitHub or Hugging Face.
messages.err_verify: A downloaded file didn't match its checksum, so Hariku deleted it. If this keeps happening, press Refresh catalogue and try again.
messages.err_size: A downloaded file had the wrong size, so Hariku deleted it.
messages.err_extract: The Piper program could not be unpacked.
messages.err_disk: Hariku couldn't save the files. Check that there is enough free disk space.
messages.err_bad_data: The voice list could not be read.
messages.err_no_runtime: The Piper program is not installed. Download a voice in Preferences, Piper Voices.
messages.err_no_voice: No Piper voice is installed. Download one in Preferences, Piper Voices.
messages.err_voice_missing: The Piper voice {voice} is not installed.
